title: Current and resistor power
hook: Change current magnitude and predict resistor power.
misconception: resistor power doubles when current magnitude doubles, regardless of the stated relationship.
objective: Apply P = I²R to compare resistor power when current magnitude changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With an ohmic resistor with fixed resistance, P = I²R. When current magnitude doubles, resistor power becomes 4 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model P = I²R; scaling exponent 2. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider an ohmic resistor with fixed resistance, with a nonzero initial result. If current magnitude triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on resistor power?
recall.why: Apply P = I²R under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 9.
